body: Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-21 04:45Z). Before reassigning an item, read its current holder with engram show or ls; a mail assignment can cross with a claim. On w-ea62eb7ebd60, three owner changes within 8 minutes (Opus3, then Sol-license, then Sol-a7bb, then back to Sol-license) happened because messages crossed and the claim was not checked. Each change cost the receivers a turn. Rule: one assignment per item, made only after confirming the item is unclaimed or held by the intended owner. If a crossing happens anyway, accept the current holder's state rather than flipping again.
